description: Miro connector (read-only). Surfaces the authenticated user's boards as miro:board items in the local index via GET /v2/boards — the board name, the description, the owner name, the create date, the last-modified timestamp, and the view link. Bearer OAuth auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth authorization-code flow; never logged); fixed SaaS host api.miro.com. The list endpoint paginates by the response cursor query param until absent; the gateway-side syncable walks a single forward pass per cycle, page-capped. Read-only — hitlRequired is intentionally empty. Sparse structured board metadata; the canonical url is the board viewLink.
author: Nimbus
